svg.title: Making the argument about public choices
svg.desc: Protect an existing habitat: Keep a woodland available for the animals that already depend on it.. Consider the objection: A private gift to research might never have funded a woodland purchase.. Test a public commitment: Ask what the council permits when it controls land use and licensing.

g.text: Making the argument about public choices
Keep a woodland available for the animals that already depend on it.
A private gift to research might never have funded a woodland purchase.
Ask what the council permits when it controls land use and licensing.
